beats.care: Check your bike or scooter's PUC expiry date now, before November 1, so you aren't stuck at the pump.
beats.what: CM Rekha Gupta announced a winter plan: no fuel without a valid PUC, and non-BS-VI vehicles from outside barred from entering.
beats.why: Delhi's air usually gets worst in winter. Vehicles, road dust and construction are big sources of the pollution.

cards.body: The Cabinet approved mechanised sweeping on 854 roads across 250 wards to cut road dust.
cards.caption: of narrow roads getting machine sweeping

cards.body: A 50% work-from-home push, staggered office hours, more e-buses and Metro use, curbs on construction, and AI cameras watching building sites.
cards.title: What else is in the plan

cards.body: The entry ban covers BS-III and BS-IV vehicles registered outside Delhi, from November 1 to January 31.

opts: To make vehicles prove their exhaust passed a check
cards.q: Why does Delhi tie fuel sales to a PUC certificate?
cards.why: A PUC certificate shows a vehicle passed an emissions check, so the rule targets polluting vehicles.

tldr: Delhi's winter anti-pollution plan starts November 1. It says vehicles without a valid PUC certificate won't get fuel, and older outside vehicles can't enter.
watch: The plan starts November 1; the entry ban on older outside vehicles runs until January 31.
